name: crypto-funding-rate-arbitrage-scanner
title: Crypto Funding Rate Arbitrage Scanner
description: Scans perpetual futures funding rates on OKX, Gate.io, MEXC, HTX, KuCoin and Bitget, and returns cross-exchange funding-rate spreads ranked by annualized return. Binance and Bybit are also supported where the caller's region allows them. Find delta-neutral carry trades in seconds.
